svg.text: oct - nov 2026
data scientist
administrative capital for urban development · new capital, egypt
smart-city iot/gis data cleaning and integration (python, sql/duckdb), documented quality checks with pii masking (law 151/2020), kpi pipeline with variance
and root-cause analysis.
built the ai component of spaceeye-geoai: inspection-file agent with verification log, complaints classifier, dashboard search/filters/map click, chatbot
integration (python, streamlit, fastapi, duckdb, chromadb, gemini, scikit-learn, google earth engine data).
sep 2025 - present
digilians program
egyptian military academy / mcit · new capital, egypt
selected from 40k+ applicants to enroll in the m.sc. at queen's university.
workshops with deloitte (pre-training vs fine-tuning, rag architectures, passive chatbots to active ai agents, etl/elt for genai, mlops lifecycle), ibm
(resume building, networking, star interviews) and dotpy (startup fundamentals, freelancing); sessions at cairo ict (cyshield) on ai agents and at edex on ai
in drones, air defense and defense systems.
oct 2024 - jun 2025
head of artificial intelligence
international modern school sayed galal · cairo, egypt
joined as ai teacher (oct - nov 2024); promoted to head of ai (dec 2024 - jun 2025), leading ai curriculum development and integration for the school's
technology program and the ai teaching team.
taught python and ai to years 5-8 and grades 7-10 across american and british curricula; trained 25 students in 5 teams for the british council code club
competition; ran internal competitions to prepare students for the code challenge championship (scratch, python, ai).
aug 2023 - aug 2025
machine learning engineer
electro pi · new cairo, egypt
designed and shipped 15+ production ml systems (harmful-prompt detector for llms, customer-service chatbot, code-quality evaluator, medical image analysis,
automated eda, automated ml).
semantic search engine (tf-idf, lsi, labse) at 87% map; sentiment pipeline (naive bayes + lstm, nltk) at 93% test accuracy; zero-code automl and autoeda
platforms.
completed 11 specialization tracks (python, eda, ml, dl, cv, nlp, llms, rag, prompt engineering, langchain).
oct 2022 - feb 2023
ai instructor
huawei ict academy · egypt
ai instructor (dec 2022 - feb 2023): hcia, python & machine learning for 30 students; authored session plans, assignments and labs.
ai intern (oct - nov 2022): completed huawei's hcia course (ai, machine learning, deep learning) and explored huawei's ai services and tools.
